Body.Content:
We're extremely excited to announce a new Azure service that makes it even easier to deploy containers. The very first service of its kind in the cloud, Azure Container Instances is a new Azure service delivering containers with great simplicity and speed, and without any Virtual Machine infrastructure to manage. Container Instances are the fastest and easiest way to run a container in the cloud.

Learn more about Container Instances.
